findings.title: uploadBlob swallows and logs where the repo's storage functions wrap the failure in a StorageError naming the key
findings.description: readBlob and deleteBlob both catch and rethrow as new StorageError(`failed to <op> blob ${key}`, { cause }). uploadBlob instead console.warns a generic message and returns null. Match the idiom: throw new StorageError(`failed to upload blob ${key}`, { cause }).
